memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The Israelites are to set up their tents by divisions, each of them in their own camp under their standard. The Levites, however, are to set up their tents around the tabernacle of the covenant law so that my wrath will not fall on the Israelite community. The Levites are to be responsible for the care of the tabernacle of the covenant law. The Israelites did all this just as the Lord commanded Moses. - Num 1:52-54 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God gave clear instructions for how the camp was to be arranged. Each tribe had its place, and the Levites camped closest to the tabernacle, forming a protective circle around God's dwelling. There was order, purpose, and reverence in the arrangement — everything centred on the presence of God in the middle of the camp.

This is a beautiful picture. God at the centre, His people arranged around Him, life organised around His presence. That is exactly how our lives are meant to be — not with God on the edges, squeezed in when convenient, but at the very centre of everything.

The chapter ends with words we have heard before: "The Israelites did all this just as the Lord commanded Moses." Once again, obedience. God spoke, and His people obeyed fully. This is the pattern of a life that pleases God — hearing His word and doing it.

For us, Christ is now the centre. He is Immanuel, "God with us" (Matt 1:23), dwelling among His people and, by His Spirit, within us. The question for each of us is simple but searching: is Christ truly at the centre of my life, or somewhere near the edge?

Arrange your life today around His presence. Everything finds its right place when He is at the centre.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Is God at the centre of your life, or on the edges?
- What would change if you truly organised your life around Him?
- Where do you need to obey God "just as He commanded"?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, be the centre of my life. Help me to arrange everything — my time, my choices, my heart — around Your presence, and to obey You fully. Amen.
